title: Pills handed out during intuitive communication training
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: And so, and he told me also there would be some pills that I would take.

plain: Between about 1990 and 1993, at an undisclosed site near the headquarters of the National Security Agency, the US government's electronic spying agency, in Maryland, trainees in a programme for intuitive, mind-to-mind communication were told they would take some pills. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says he was recruited to communicate with aliens this way, tells it from his own experience. He says an officer he names as Captain White told him about the pills, which suggests the programme used drugs to help the training.
